items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: And this one guy, Jack Lyons, had been the editor. And he said, you know, “Why don’t you become the sports editor?

ctx.x: Were you aware that most of those players were black?

Oh yeah. Because a couple of those 78 albums had the pictures you know. Sometimes they had drawings, you know, like Fats Waller with big lips and everything. But I loved those guys, and as I read about jazz, you know, most of these guys were black, and especially the foreign writers. They were very sympathetic to that world, and very few of these guys who were writing who were American were the prejudiced ones, the early ones. So I came up reading about these guys, and then in high school, you know, it was the…
